name: jev-native
description: Operate native macOS apps and windows with a Swift controller, JEV action selection, a separate virtual cursor, and a hideable target-window preview. Use for requested desktop app workflows; Codex delegates original text and image interpretation when needed.

interface.shortDescription: Native macOS automation with a virtual cursor and target preview
interface.longDescription: Operate native macOS apps and windows with a Swift controller, JEV action selection, a separate virtual cursor, and a hideable target-window preview. Use for requested desktop app workflows; Codex delegates original text and image interpretation when needed. Stable source snapshot; runtime and credentials are separate. No app, hook or MCP is installed by this Plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use $jev-native to operate the requested macOS app with JEV and verify the final window state.
